messages:
Nia Lopez: hey team :wave: i'm Nia — joining eng-infra as an infra eng. excited to be here! neon sneakers, amateur guitar, big oolong tea stan. WFH Tue/Thu. quick q: where's the office bike rack and is there Oolong in the kitchen? also any Friday after-work jam sessions? :guitar:
HR-bot: Welcome Nia! Please check the onboarding checklist at https://intra.redwood.com/onboarding and complete the 'Security & Badge' step. If you need a desk plant, ping #people-ops. :partyparrot:
Carmen Hu: welcome!! :tada: bike rack is behind the loading dock (door B). we have loose-leaf oolong in the navy tin in the kitchen, but there's also a tea drawer by the kettle. fridge space is upstairs on level 3. ping me if you want a campus tour :)
Devon Park: hi Nia — welcome! we do a casual jam most Fridays at 5pm in the lounge. bring uke/guitar/electronic kazoo. count me in for oolong refills :tea:
Marco Rivera: i have an extra patch cable and a small amp you can borrow for the jam. also scooter meetup on Mon mornings if you're into that.
Nia Lopez: amazing, thanks y'all! i'll bring my (very small) amp and a questionable 3-chord set. @Marco yes please about the cable. Carmen — i'll take that tour tomorrow at 11 if you're free :)
Carmen Hu: 11 works. see you at the 2nd floor atrium. :coffee:
